# LuxeMia

> Indian ethnic wear boutique based in Philadelphia, USA. Founded by Mini (Bhamini), who grew up in Gujarat and married into a Surat textile family. Sells sarees, lehengas, suits, menswear, and jewelry sourced from family contacts in Surat, Kanchipuram, Banaras, and Gujarat. Ships from India in 2-3 weeks. Personal support in English, Hindi, and Gujarati.
